knowledge:
- key_parameters: Data=A SingleCellExperiment object containing raw counts and metadata (spike-ins or batch info) ;; N=Total number of MCMC iterations (recommended default is 20000) ;; Thin=Thinning period for MCMC chain (recommended default is 20) ;; Burn=Burn-in period iterations to discard (recommended default is 10000) ;; Regression=Logical; if TRUE, infers a global regression trend between mean expression and over-dispersion to calculate residual over-dispersion (recommended default) ;; WithSpikes=Logical; set to FALSE if technical spike-in molecules are not available (requires batch information) ;; VarThreshold=Threshold for the proportion of biological variability used to define highly variable genes (HVG) or lowly variable genes (LVG) ;; EpsilonM=Log2 fold change threshold for mean expression differential testing ;; EpsilonD=Log2 fold change threshold for over-dispersion differential testing ;; Offset=Logical; if TRUE, performs internal offset correction to adjust for differences in overall mRNA content
- alternatives: scater=Mentioned as an alternative package providing enhanced functionality for the pre-processing and quality control of scRNA-seq datasets
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing single-cell RNA-seq datasets from supervised experiments where cell groups (e.g., experimental conditions, cell types) are known a priori, and you want to perform normalization, quantify technical noise, identify highly/lowly variable genes, or test for differential expression and variability between groups.
- pitfalls: Do NOT use BASiCS in unsupervised settings where the goal is to discover sub-populations of cells through clustering ;; Ensure MCMC acceptance rates displayed in the console are around 0.44; if they are too far, increase N and Burn ;; If WithSpikes = FALSE, BASiCS_MCMC will fail to run if only a single batch of samples is provided (multiple batches must be specified via BatchInfo) ;; When analyzing multiple groups of cells, gene filtering must be jointly applied across all groups (using BASiCS_Filter) to ensure the same genes are retained ;; In the non-regression model (Regression = FALSE), changes in over-dispersion can only be assessed for genes where mean expression does not change (use EpsilonM = 0 to avoid confounding)

workflows.name: single_group_hvg_lvg_detection
workflows.intent: Quantify technical noise, normalize data, and identify highly and lowly variable genes within a single group of cells.
input: counts_matrix.csv (raw expression counts with biological and optional spike-in genes)
spike_info.csv (optional data frame containing spike-in names and absolute molecule counts)
batch_info.csv (optional vector indicating batch structure, required if no spike-ins are used)
workflows.stages: 1. Format input data into a SingleCellExperiment object using newBASiCS_Data ;; 2. Run the MCMC sampler using BASiCS_MCMC ;; 3. Detect highly variable genes (HVG) and lowly variable genes (LVG) using BASiCS_DetectHVG and BASiCS_DetectLVG ;; 4. Visualize variability and extract results using BASiCS_PlotVG and as.data.frame ;; 5. Generate denoised counts or rates using BASiCS_DenoisedCounts or BASiCS_DenoisedRates
workflows.code:
# 1. Data preparation (with spikes)
Counts <- matrix(rpois(50 * 40, 2), ncol = 40)
rownames(Counts) <- c(paste0("Gene", 1:40), paste0("Spike", 1:10))
colnames(Counts) <- paste0("Cell", 1:40)
Tech <- c(rep(FALSE, 40), rep(TRUE, 10))
SpikeInput <- rgamma(10, 1, 1)
SpikeInfo <- data.frame(
  "SpikeID" = paste0("Spike", 1:10),
  "SpikeInput" = SpikeInput
)
DataExample <- newBASiCS_Data(Counts, Tech, SpikeInfo)

# 1b. Data preparation (without spikes, requires batch info)
CountsNoSpikes <- matrix(rpois(50 * 40, 2), ncol = 40)
rownames(CountsNoSpikes) <- paste0("Gene", 1:50)
colnames(CountsNoSpikes) <- paste0("Cell", 1:40)
DataExampleNoSpikes <- SingleCellExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = CountsNoSpikes),
  colData = data.frame(BatchInfo = rep(c(1, 2), each = 20))
)

# 2. Run MCMC sampler
Chain <- BASiCS_MCMC(
  Data = DataExample,
  N = 1000, Thin = 10, Burn = 500,
  PrintProgress = FALSE, Regression = TRUE
)

# 3. Detect HVG and LVG
HVG <- BASiCS_DetectHVG(Chain, VarThreshold = 0.6)
LVG <- BASiCS_DetectLVG(Chain, VarThreshold = 0.2)

# 4. Plot and extract results
plot_grid(
  BASiCS_PlotVG(HVG, "Grid"),
  BASiCS_PlotVG(HVG, "VG")
)
as.data.frame(HVG)
as.data.frame(LVG)

# 5. Obtain denoised counts and rates
DenoisedCounts <- BASiCS_DenoisedCounts(Data = DataExample, Chain = Chain)
DenoisedRates <- BASiCS_DenoisedRates(
  Data = DataExample, Chain = Chain,
  Propensities = FALSE
)

workflows.name: two_group_differential_expression
workflows.intent: Identify changes in gene expression mean, over-dispersion, and residual over-dispersion between two groups of cells.
workflows.stages: 1. Perform differential expression testing using BASiCS_TestDE ;; 2. Extract results for mean, dispersion, or residual over-dispersion parameters using as.data.frame ;; 3. Append custom gene metadata using rowData ;; 4. Visualize differential expression results using BASiCS_PlotDE
workflows.code:
# 1. Run differential expression test
Test <- BASiCS_TestDE(
  Chain1 = ChainSC, Chain2 = ChainRNA,
  GroupLabel1 = "SC", GroupLabel2 = "PaS",
  EpsilonM = log2(1.5), EpsilonD = log2(1.5),
  EFDR_M = 0.10, EFDR_D = 0.10,
  Offset = TRUE, PlotOffset = TRUE, Plot = TRUE
)

# 2. Access results for different parameters
head(as.data.frame(Test, Parameter = "Mean"))
head(as.data.frame(Test, Parameter = "Disp"))

# 3. Add and format row metadata
rowData(Test) <- cbind(rowData(Test), Index = 1:nrow(rowData(Test)))
as.data.frame(Test, Parameter = "Mean")

# 4. Visualize results
BASiCS_PlotDE(Test)
BASiCS_PlotDE(Test, Plots = c("MA", "Volcano"))
BASiCS_PlotDE(Test, Plots = "MA", Parameters = "Mean")
